title: Royalty Split Validator
description: Validates on-chain royalty split configurations against ERC-2981 (single-receiver) and 0xSplits (multi-recipient) rules. Checks Ethereum address format, per-recipient share range, sum integrity, duplicate detection, and optional per-recipient cap. Returns a deterministic config fingerprint for audit trails. Not legal advice.

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_royalty_split
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validates on-chain royalty split configurations against ERC-2981 (single-receiver) and 0xSplits (multi-recipient) rules. Checks address format, share range, sum integrity, and duplicates. Not legal advice.

entries.description: Array of {address, basis_points} or {address, percent} objects

basis_points.description: Share in basis points (0-10000); sum must equal 10000

percent.description: Share as percentage (0-100); sum must equal 100

config.description: JSON string of entries array (alternative to entries field)

cap_bps.description: Optional per-recipient cap in basis points (0-10000)
